WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO processed_messages (mid, tenant_id, channel, event)
  VALUES ($1, NULL, 'web', convert_from(decode($2,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (mid) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event
)
SELECT ins.event,
       (ins.event->>'page_id') AS page_id,
       (ins.event->>'mid') AS mid,
       t.tenant_id,
       t.config
FROM ins
LEFT JOIN tenants t
  ON t.external_page_id = (ins.event->>'page_id')
 AND t.channel = 'web'
 AND t.is_active = true;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO pending_messages (tenant_id, channel, customer_id, mid, text_b64) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (mid) DO NOTHING RETURNING id;

SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pending_messages p
  WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.channel = $2 AND p.customer_id = $3 AND p.processed_at IS NULL
    AND p.id > (SELECT id FROM pending_messages
                WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND channel = $2 AND customer_id = $3 AND mid = $4
                ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
) AS has_newer;

WITH claimed AS (
  UPDATE pending_messages SET processed_at = now()
  WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND channel = $2 AND customer_id = $3 AND processed_at IS NULL
  RETURNING id, text_b64
)
SELECT string_agg(convert_from(decode(text_b64,'base64'),'UTF8'), E'\n' ORDER BY id) AS text,
       count(*)::int AS messages_count
FROM claimed;

nodes.name: Prepare Lead Params
nodes.notes: Base64-параметры: запятые в тексте не ломают SQL.

parameters.query:
WITH prev AS (
  SELECT lead_status, lead_notified_at, handover_notified_at, handover_reason
  FROM leads WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND channel = $2 AND customer_id = $3
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (
    tenant_id, channel, customer_id, username, display_name, phone, service_interest, city,
    lead_status, lead_data, summary, handover_required, handover_reason
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3,
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($4,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($5,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($6,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($7,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($8,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    $9,
    convert_from(decode($10,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb,
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($11,'base64'),'UTF8'),''),
    $12::boolean,
    NULLIF(convert_from(decode($13,'base64'),'UTF8'),'')
  )
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, channel, customer_id) DO UPDATE SET
    username         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.username, leads.username),
    display_name     = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, leads.display_name),
    phone            = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, leads.phone),
    service_interest = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.service_interest, leads.service_interest),
    city             = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.city, leads.city),
    lead_data        = leads.lead_data || EXCLUDED.lead_data,
    lead_status      = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.lead_status = 'in_progress' THEN leads.lead_status ELSE EXCLUDED.lead_status END,
    summary          = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.summary,''), leads.summary),
    handover_required = EXCLUDED.handover_required OR leads.handover_required,
    handover_reason  = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.handover_reason,''), leads.handover_reason),
    updated_at       = now()
  RETURNING lead_status, handover_required, handover_reason
)
SELECT up.lead_status, up.handover_required, up.handover_reason,
  (($14::boolean) AND up.lead_status IN ('qualified','handover')
   AND (SELECT lead_notified_at FROM prev) IS NULL) AS should_notify_lead,
  (($15::boolean) AND up.handover_required AND (
      (SELECT handover_notified_at FROM prev) IS NULL
      OR (SELECT handover_reason FROM prev) IS DISTINCT FROM up.handover_reason
      OR (SELECT handover_notified_at FROM prev) < now() - make_interval(hours => $16)
  )) AS should_notify_handover
FROM up;

WITH up AS (
  UPDATE leads SET muted_until = now() + make_interval(hours => $4)
  WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND channel = $2 AND customer_id = $3
  RETURNING 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (tenant_id, channel, customer_id, muted_until)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, now() + make_interval(hours => $4)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM up)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT 1 AS ok;
